thought.text: Muncul dua masalah: **username bentrok** dan **"Captcha must be filled out"**. Captcha baru muncul setelah username valid. Saya perbaiki username dan lihat captcha-nya.

cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 280 python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -25
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import time,random
em=f"kg{int(time.time())}@sinaja.cyou"; un=f"kgtest{random.randint(10000,99999)}"
print("email:",em,"| user:",un)
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    pg=b.new_page(viewport={"width":1366,"height":900})
    pg.goto("https://www.kaggle.com/account/login?phase=startRegisterTab",wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=90000)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(5000)
    pg.click("text=Register with Email"); pg.wait_for_timeout(6000)
    pg.fill('input[name="email"]',em)
    pg.fill('input[name="password"]',"Kaggle!2026xyz")
    pg.locator('input[type="text"]').first.fill("Kaggle Tester")
    pg.click("text=Next"); pg.wait_for_timeout(7000)
    # isi username
    try:
        pg.click("text=Edit",timeout=5000); pg.wait_for_timeout(1500)
    except Exception: pass
    uinp=pg.locator('input[type="text"]')
    print("jumlah input text:",uinp.count())
    for i in range(uinp.count()):
        print(" ",i,uinp.nth(i).get_attribute("name"),uinp.nth(i).get_attribute("value"),uinp.nth(i).get_attribute("placeholder"))
    print("recaptcha frame:",[f.url[:70] for f in pg.frames if "recaptcha" in f.url])
    pg.screenshot(path="/tmp/kgcap.png")
    b.close()
PY
